episodes.title: SHE ESCAPED A CULT | CHANTELLE'S INCREDIBLE STORY
episodes.description:
In this powerful episode of *Women Healing Naturally*, **Chantal** shares one of the most personal stories of her life—how she escaped a cult and found the courage to rebuild her life.

Today, Chantal is an incredible naturopath who helps people heal, but her journey to get here wasn't easy. She opens up about living in a controlling environment, how manipulation can happen so gradually that you don't even realise you're in a cult, and what it took to finally walk away.

This conversation is about awareness, resilience, and hope. If you've ever wondered how intelligent, caring people can become trapped in controlling relationships or groups, this episode offers valuable insight into the warning signs and the importance of trusting yourself.

We hope this conversation encourages anyone who may be experiencing coercion or control to know they're not alone, and that freedom and healing are possible.

💚 We'd love to hear your thoughts in the comments. Have you ever experienced a controlling relationship or learned something from someone else's story that changed your perspective?
